Apply g support to x1 and expand x1-y=(1-lambda)(x1-x2).
Apply same g support to x2 and expand x2-y=lambda(x2-x1).
Multiply by nonnegative lambda and 1-lambda; add and cancel; conclude convexity of restriction.
